import unittest

from solution import ReadingVault


class ReadingVaultTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_vault(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        self.assertEqual(vault.names(), [])
        self.assertEqual(vault.snapshot(), {})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            vault.get("missing")

    def test_put_get_replace_and_normalization(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        self.assertEqual(vault.put(" sensor ", {"value": 1}), "sensor")
        self.assertEqual(vault.get(" sensor "), {"value": 1})
        self.assertEqual(vault.put("sensor", {"value": 2}), "sensor")
        self.assertEqual(vault.get("sensor"), {"value": 2})
        self.assertEqual(vault.names(), ["sensor"])

    def test_sorted_names_and_snapshot(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        vault.put("zeta", {"v": 3})
        vault.put("alpha", {"v": 1})
        vault.put("middle", {"v": 2})
        self.assertEqual(vault.names(), ["alpha", "middle", "zeta"])
        snapshot = vault.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(list(snapshot), ["alpha", "middle", "zeta"])
        self.assertEqual(snapshot, {
            "alpha": {"v": 1}, "middle": {"v": 2}, "zeta": {"v": 3}
        })

    def test_name_validation_on_all_name_methods(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        for name in (None, 1, True, []):
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    vault.put(name, {})
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    vault.get(name)
        for name in ("", "   "):
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    vault.put(name, {})
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    vault.get(name)

    def test_payload_type(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        for payload in (None, [], (), "data", 1):
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    vault.put("name", payload)

    def test_deep_copy_input_and_get_result(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        payload = {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}}
        vault.put("n", payload)
        payload["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        fetched = vault.get("n")
        self.assertEqual(fetched, {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}})
        fetched["nested"]["values"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(vault.get("n"), {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}})

    def test_snapshot_is_deeply_isolated(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        vault.put("n", {"nested": [{"value": 1}]})
        first = vault.snapshot()
        first["n"]["nested"][0]["value"] = 99
        first["extra"] = {}
        second = vault.snapshot()
        self.assertEqual(second, {"n": {"nested": [{"value": 1}]}})
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_names_returns_fresh_list(self):
        vault = ReadingVault()
        vault.put("b", {})
        vault.put("a", {})
        names = vault.names()
        names.clear()
        self.assertEqual(vault.names(), ["a", "b"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
